name: Steal Or Die [UPDATE!]
desc:
🔦Escape the monster,  steal loot — or BE the monster

You have minutes to loot the building. Something is hunting you the whole time.

💰 STEAL — 31 items to grab, from phones to gold bars. The rarer the loot, the bigger the payout… and the slower you run.
🚪 HIDE — closets, vents, barricaded doors. It hears your footsteps. It hears your voice.
👹 OR BE THE MONSTER — play as the entity and hunt your friends.

[VERSION 1.45]: MANY IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES + FACILITY AND OFFICE MAP EXPANSIONS

★ 4 maps: Facility, Office, American Dorm and Supermarket!
★ 4 entities: The Locust, The Hollow and etc...
★ Skill trees, upgrades and 10 rebirths

🚨AI Assistance Disclosure: AI tools were utilized to assist with UI development, bug fixes, and optimization across select maps, as the game is developed and maintained by a solo developer.

🥽 FULL VR SUPPORT
📱 FULL PHONE & TABLET SUPPORT
🖥️ PC
🎮 CONSOLE

Bring friends. Don't trust them.

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
